headlines.text: Flash back to 2024, when Swerve Strickland vs. Will Ospreay fought tooth and nail for the AEW World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Forbidden Door, rated 9.23 ? an outstanding performance from both sides. In a Match of the Year contender, Strickland kicked out of the Hidden Blade twice before finally putting Ospreay away with a third House Call and Big Pressure to retain the AEW World Title.
Turning the clock back to 2023: Samoa Joe vs. Roderick Strong met in an Owen Hart Tournament Match, closing out the card as the main event on Collision, rated 7.32 ? a well-worked match.

That Wednesday in 2021, MJF vs. Sammy Guevara closed out Dynamite, rated 8.21 ? a hard-hitting, high-quality battle in a hard-fought men's division clash, part of the special Fan Appreciation Night '21 card.

secondaries.text: On a Sunday in 2024, back when the AEW TNT Title changed hands as Jack Perry vs. Dante Martin vs. El Phantasmo vs. Konosuke Takeshita vs. Lio Rush vs. Mark Briscoe battled it out in a Ladder match, appearing on Forbidden Door, rated 7.68 ? a match that delivered ? ending the champion's reign at 6 defenses. For El Phantasmo and Lio Rush and Mark Briscoe, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. Perry hung back and picked his spots amid a violent ladder war filled with Takeshita brainbusters on ladders, capitalizing to win the vacant TNT Championship.

On this day in 2024, there was a changing of the guard for the IWGP World Heavyweight Title as Tetsuya Naito vs. Jon Moxley battled it out, appearing on Forbidden Door, rated 4.23 ? ending the champion's reign at 2 defenses. It was the first title opportunity of Tetsuya Naito's career. Naito hit the Destino to defeat Moxley, unifying the IWGP and AEW International Titles and becoming the sole heavyweight champion between the two promotions.

Back on this day in 2024, Mercedes Mone vs. Stephanie Vaquer put the AEW TBS Title on the line, appearing on Forbidden Door, rated 7.61 ? a well-worked match. Stephanie Vaquer was challenging for gold for the very first time.
